card.name: Inside lists of risk factors and alternatives
card.fires_on: Negative pole: fires on a word that sits inside a list of patient groups, doses or options, such as partway through a drug name or on 'are' after 'alternative treatment options'. It also fires on commas inside lists of dose ranges.
